nextReadySlice.title: Wider manifest inspection projection surface
failingProof: A failing proof shows the next inspection consumer or projection surface is not yet available on top of the approved hosted canonical JSON boundary.
A failing proof shows the next projection would cross the runtime/source-generator boundary if it stops consuming canonical JSON as the source of truth.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Require human review before any broader CLI/tooling or production-facing inspection contract lands, and keep richer inspection surfaces consuming canonical hosted JSON instead of adding a runtime-side manifest model.
